verdict.rationale: Sierra Agent Studio/SDK explicitly supports defining step-by-step workflows (journeys) from scratch or generated from existing SOPs, with logic/branching, version tracking, and testing to avoid regressions — directly matching the SOP-encoding, deterministic-branching use case. Ghostwriter further allows uploading SOPs/transcripts to auto-generate these journeys. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of deterministic branching behavior in production and no third-party case study confirming SOP fidelity at scale.
